_about: Release 0 demonstration route: Pulaski Bridge corridor (Greenpoint, Brooklyn <-> Long Island City, Queens). Road data: Overture Maps 2026-09-23.1 transportation (OSM-derived, ODbL). 'bbox' is the build selection; 'inventory_bbox' is a larger read window so roads leaving the build are known (transitions). 'nycroads build' writes build/r0-demo/demo_acceptance.json with the result of each required-feature check on the real data.
